define.problem: Wave labels and PRs have accumulated across repositories, missions, repair iterations and handovers. Numeric W### order is not a reliable chronology, W### labels are reused, and some named next actions can remain in handovers without a durable successor edge.
define.objective: Create one recursive Golden Thread for the canonical seven-wave analysis subset and every observed PR in its repair/supersession neighborhood, while retaining a breadth inventory of all quoted W### labels.
non_goals: No rewriting of historical zero-step or superseded evidence

observed_temporal_facts: W287 PR #1538 merged 2026-09-18 before the QPS RTM-hierarchy W277 PR #1588 merged 2026-09-21.
MissionControl HM-01 used W277/W278/W279 on 2026-09-18 for a different semantic family than QPS RTM hierarchy W277/W278/W279 on 2026-09-21.
W329 PR #1679 was created after #1678 but merged before #1678, so created-order and merge-order are distinct.
W281-R4 had multiple competing candidates (#1605/#1606/#1607/#1631); only #1607 became the canonical merged R4 in that candidate cluster.

root_causes.cause: Wave labels are local identifiers reused across repository/mission families.
root_causes.effect: Naive W### joins create false lineage.

root_causes.cause: Wave number encodes a work label, not wall-clock sequence.
One wave can carry multiple lanes/updates.
root_causes.effect: repo+family+W### can still collide, as observed for W287 Table3 versus DREQ-gap.

root_causes.cause: PR authoring and merging are concurrent.
root_causes.effect: created chronology and applied/merge chronology can diverge.

root_causes.cause: Handover prose may name the next bounded objective without allocating a durable issue/PR.
root_causes.effect: A real continuation can be discoverable but not consumed.

changes: PRs are independent first-class nodes, never inferred from wave numbering.
Both created_at chronology and merged_at application chronology are retained.
Superseded and closed-unmerged PRs remain in the graph instead of disappearing from the current view.
Edge vocabulary explicitly separates SEMANTIC_SUCCESSOR, CORRECTED_BY, HARDENED_BY, SUPERSEDED_BY, AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE_CORRECTION, RESTART_SURFACE_SYNC and NAMED_NEXT_OBJECTIVE_UNCONSUMED.
Unfinished work is classified as TRUE_UNCONSUMED_NEXT_OBJECTIVE, EXTERNAL_HOLD, EXECUTION_ADMISSION_HOLD, SUPERSEDED, or HISTORICAL_RESOLVED_GATE.
The previously unconsumed W287_DREQ_SOURCE_INTEGRATION_REVIEW was allocated as durable successor issue GBOGEB/cryoplant-project#1801.
Post-merge P2 repair connects QPS PRs #1678/#1679 and the #1733/#1736 runtime-recovery pair into the W329 recursive subgraph; PR #1733 closed_at=2026-09-24T10:16:15Z.

first_action_after_control.guard: Owner/source integration only; issue existence and candidate rows grant zero engineering/compliance/formal credit.

control.recurrence_rule: On every new PR or wave handover, append PR node + wave/lane key + predecessor/successor/supersession edges; never rewrite prior nodes. If a handover names a next objective and no durable successor exists, flag TRUE_UNCONSUMED_NEXT_OBJECTIVE.

result: DMAIC_CONTROL_CORRECTED_POSTMERGE: canonical subset remains PASS after bounded P2 repair; 29 PR nodes, 32 edges, 0 dangling edges; W287 successor #1801 retained.
